text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City Policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to implement a "No Stopping Anytime" regulation on the south side of Merton Street, fronting the driveway of Nos. 119 and 139 Merton Street. This change will improve the sightlines between motorists travelling east-west and motorists exiting the driveway and will not result in the loss any parking spaces on Merton Street.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times, on the south side of Merton Street, from a point 322.1 metres east of Yonge Street and a point 18.2 metres east further east. 2. Prohibited stopping on the south side of Merton Street, from a point 322.1 metres east of Yonge Street to a point 18.2 metres further east.
